Definition: from a derivative of the base of G2425 (through the idea of approaching for a favor); intreaty:--supplication.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, hiketēría means supplication. It occurs just once, in Hebrews.
TheologicalSignificance: I take hiketēría as it stands — supplication — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
